versions.changelog:
- Added a complete backend implementation for Backboard integration, including API routes, models, and services.
- Introduced backend startup script and configuration files for easy deployment.
- Implemented support for assistants, threads, memories, and document RAG operations via local Flask backend.
- No changes to the user-facing skill documentation or instructions.

- SKILL.md was condensed for clarity, moving to a brief summary and removing repetition.
- Detailed description moved to the description field; the intro section is now shorter.
- Tool definitions and parameters remain unchanged.
- Examples, guidelines, and backend setup instructions are still included but are more succinct.
- No functional or API changes; documentation only.
